files.shabads/4/2472.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2472,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":13,"page_no":650,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":28096,"last_verse_id":28101,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Sorath","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":28096,"page_no":650,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":28097,"page_no":650,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿੰਨ ਕੰਉ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖਾ ॥","translit_en":"hau balihaaree ti(n)n ka(n)au jo gurmukh sikhaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I am a sacrifice to those Sikhs who are Gurmukhs.","ms":"I am a sacrifice unto those, who are the God-conscious sikhs of the Guru."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਸਿੱਖ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਹਨ, ਮੈਂ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਸਦਕੇ ਹਾਂ "}}},{"verse_id":28098,"page_no":650,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਿਖਾ ॥","translit_en":"jo har naam dhiaaidhe tin dharasan pikhaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I behold the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of those who meditate on the Lord's Name.","ms":"I see the sight of those, who meditate on the Lord's Name."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਹਰੀ-ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਦੇ ਹਨ (ਜੀ ਚਾਹੰੁਦਾ ਹੈ) ਮੈਂ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਕਰਾਂ"}}},{"verse_id":28099,"page_no":650,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਣਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਲਿਖਾ ॥","translit_en":"sun keeratan har gun ravaa har jas man likhaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Listening to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, I contemplate His virtues; I write His Praises on the fabric of my mind.","ms":"Hearing Lord's praise, I utter His virtues and inscribe God's glory in my mind."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹਨਾਂ ਪਾਸੋਂ) ਕੀਰਤਨ ਸੁਣ ਕੇ ਹਰੀ ਦੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾਂ ਤੇ ਹਰੀ-ਜਸ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਉੱਕਰ ਲਵਾਂ"}}},{"verse_id":28100,"page_no":650,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕ੍ਰਿਖਾ ॥","translit_en":"har naam salaahee ra(n)g siau sabh kilavikh kirakhaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I praise the Lord's Name with love, and eradicate all my sins.","ms":"I praise the Lord's Name with love and up-root all my sins."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨਾਲ ਹਰੀ-ਨਾਮ ਦੀ ਸਿਫ਼ਤਿ ਕਰਾਂ ਤੇ (ਆਪਣੇ) ਸਾਰੇ ਪਾਪ ਕੱਟ ਦਿਆਂ ।"}}},{"verse_id":28101,"page_no":650,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸੋ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਧਰੇ ਵਿਖਾ ॥੧੯॥","translit_en":"dhan dha(n)n suhaavaa so sareer thaan hai jithai meraa gur dhare vikhaa ||19||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Blessed, blessed and beauteous is that body and place, where my Guru places His feet. ||19||","ms":"Blest, blest and beauteous is the body and place, whereon my Guru plant his foot."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹ ਸਰੀਰ-ਥਾਂ ਧੰਨ ਹੈ, ਸੁੰਦਰ ਹੈ ਜਿਥੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪੈਰ ਰੱਖਦਾ ਹੈ (ਭਾਵ, ਆ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ) ।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2471,"next":2473}}
files.shabads/4/2473.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2473,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":13,"page_no":650,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":28102,"last_verse_id":28104,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Sorath","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":28102,"page_no":650,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Third Mehla:","ms":"Slok 3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":28103,"page_no":650,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥","translit_en":"gur bin giaan na hoviee naa sukh vasai man aai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without the Guru, spiritual wisdom is not obtained, and peace does not come to abide in the mind.","ms":"Without the Guru, gnosis is not obtained, nor peace comes and abides in the mind."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹ ਆਤਮਕ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੀ ਸਮਝ ਪੈਂਦੀ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਨਾਹ ਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ"}}},{"verse_id":28104,"page_no":650,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"naanak naam vihoone manmukhee jaasan janam gavai ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the self-willed manmukhs depart, after having wasted their lives. ||1||","ms":"Nanak, without the Name, the self-willed shall depart after wasting their life."},"pu":{"ss":"ਗੁਰੂ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾ) ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਨਾਮ ਤੋਂ ਸੱਖਣੇ (ਰਹਿ ਕੇ) ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਨੁੱਖਾ-ਜਨਮ ਵਿਅਰਥ ਗਵਾ ਜਾਣਗੇ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2472,"next":2474}}
files.shabads/4/2474.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2474,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":13,"page_no":650,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":28105,"last_verse_id":28110,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Sorath","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":28105,"page_no":650,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Third Mehla:","ms":"3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":28106,"page_no":650,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਸਭਿ ਖੋਜਦੇ ਥਕਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"sidh saadhik naavai no sabh khojadhe thak rahe liv lai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All the Siddhas, spiritual masters and seekers search for the Name; "}}},{"verse_id":28107,"page_no":650,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"bin satigur kinai na paio gurmukh milai milai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without the True Guru, no one finds the Name; "}}},{"verse_id":28109,"page_no":650,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਾ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਾਤਿ ॥","translit_en":"saa sidh saa karamaat hai achi(n)t kare jis dhaat ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That alone is spirituality, and that alone is miraculous power, which the Carefree Lord spontaneously bestows.","ms":"That alone is the saintliness and that the occult-power, which the carefree Lord gives as His gift."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਹੀ (ਉਸ ਦੀ) ਸਿੱਧੀ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਇਹੀ ਕਰਾਮਾਤ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਿਤ ਹਰੀ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ (ਨਾਮ ਦੀ) ਦਾਤਿ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੇ;"}}},{"verse_id":28110,"page_no":650,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਏਹਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਏਹਾ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"naanak gurmukh har naam man vasai ehaa sidh ehaa karamaat ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, the Lord's Name abides in the mind of the Gurmukh; This alone is the miraculous might and this the extra psychic power."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! “ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਹਰੀ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ”—ਇਹੀ ਸਿੱਧੀ ਤੇ ਕਰਾਮਾਤ ਹੰੁਦੀ ਹੈ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2473,"next":2475}}
files.shabads/4/2475.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2475,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":13,"page_no":650,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":28111,"last_verse_id":28116,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Sorath","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":28111,"page_no":650,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":28112,"page_no":650,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਹਮ ਢਾਢੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖਸਮ ਕੇ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਛੰਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"ham ddaaddee har prabh khasam ke nit gaaveh har gun chha(n)taa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I am a minstrel of God, my Lord and Master; every day, I sing the songs of the Lord's Glorious Praises.","ms":"I am a minstrel of God, my Lord Master, and I daily sing the songs of God's praise."},"pu":{"ss":"ਅਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ-ਖਸਮ ਦੇ ਢਾਢੀ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਗੁਣਾਂ ਦੇ ਗੀਤ ਗਾਂਦੇ ਹਾਂ"}}},{"verse_id":28113,"page_no":650,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਹ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣਹ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਵਲਾ ਕੰਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"har keeratan kareh har jas suneh tis kavalaa ka(n)taa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and I listen to the Praises of the Lord, the Master of wealth and Maya.","ms":"I sing God's praise and hear the excellences of that God, the Lord of wealth."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਕਮਲਾਪਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਹੀ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਜਸ ਸੁਣਦੇ ਹਾਂ "}}},{"verse_id":28114,"page_no":650,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਭਿਖਾਰੀਆ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਜੰਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"har dhaataa sabh jagat bhikhaareeaa ma(n)gat jan ja(n)taa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord is the Great Giver; all the world is begging; all beings and creatures are beggars.","ms":"The Lord alone is the Donor and the whole world is a mumper. The mortals and other beings are His beggars."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਹੈ, ਸਾਰਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ ਹੈ, ਜੀਵ ਜੰਤ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਹਨ "}}},{"verse_id":28115,"page_no":650,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਮ ਜੰਤਾ ॥","translit_en":"har dhevahu dhaan dhiaal hoi vich paathar kiram ja(n)taa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Lord, You are kind and compassionate; You give Your gifts to even worms and insects among the rocks.","ms":"My God, Thou mercifully givest gifts even to the worms and insects in the stones."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪੱਥਰਾਂ ਵਿਚਲੇ ਕੀੜਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਭੀ ਦਿਆਲ ਹੋ ਕੇ, ਹੇ ਹਰੀ! ਤੂੰ ਦਾਨ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈਂ ।"}}},{"verse_id":28116,"page_no":650,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ॥੨੦॥","translit_en":"jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa gurmukh dhanava(n)taa ||20||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, he has become truly wealthy. ||20||","ms":"Deliberating over the Name, through the Guru, slave Nanak has become wealthy."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ! ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਹੈ, ਉਹ (ਅਸਲ) ਧਨੀ ਹੰੁਦੇ ਹਨ "}}}],"nav":{"prev":2474,"next":2476}}
files.shabads/4/2476.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2476,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":13,"page_no":650,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":7,"first_verse_id":28117,"last_verse_id":28123,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Sorath","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":28117,"page_no":650,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Third Mehla:","ms":"Slok 3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":28118,"page_no":650,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਪੜਣਾ ਗੁੜਣਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"paRanaa guRanaa sa(n)saar kee kaar hai a(n)dhar tirasanaa vikaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Reading and studying are just worldly pursuits, if there is thirst and corruption within.","ms":"Reading and reflecting are worldly affairs, if there are avarice and sin within."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪੜ੍ਹਨਾ ਤੇ ਵਿਚਾਰਨਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਦਾ ਕੰਮ (ਹੀ ਹੋ ਗਿਆ) ਹੈ (ਭਾਵ, ਹੋਰ ਵਿਹਾਰਾਂ ਵਾਂਗ ਇਹ ਭੀ ਇਕ ਵਿਹਾਰ ਹੀ ਬਣ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ, ਪਰ) ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਤ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨਾ ਤੇ ਵਿਕਾਰ (ਟਿਕੇ ਹੀ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ) ਹਨ"}}},{"verse_id":28119,"page_no":650,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭਿ ਪੜਿ ਥਕੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"haumai vich sabh paR thake dhoojai bhai khuaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Reading in egotism, all have grown weary; through the love of duality, they are ruined.","ms":"Reading through egotism, all are grown weary and are ruined by the love of another."},"pu":{"ss":"ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਵਿਚ ਸਾਰੇ (ਪੰਡਿਤ) ਪੜ੍ਹ ਪੜ੍ਹ ਕੇ ਥੱਕ ਗਏ ਹਨ, ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਚ ਖ਼ੁਆਰ ਹੀ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":28120,"page_no":650,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"so paRiaa so pa(n)ddit beenaa gur sabadh kare veechaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He alone is educated, and he alone is a wise Pandit, who contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.","ms":"He alone is literate and he alone a wise Pandit, who ponders over Guru's hymns."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਪੜ੍ਹਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਤੇ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਹੈ (ਭਾਵ, ਉਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸਮਝੋ), ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਵਿਚ ਵਿਚਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, "}}},{"verse_id":28121,"page_no":650,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਜੈ ਤਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)dhar khojai tat lahai paae mokh dhuaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He searches within himself, and finds the true essence; he finds the Door of Salvation.","ms":"He searches his mind, finds the quintessence and obtains the door of salvation."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਪੜ੍ਹਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਤੇ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਹੈ (ਭਾਵ, ਉਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸਮਝੋ), ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਵਿਚ ਵਿਚਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, "}}},{"verse_id":28122,"page_no":650,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"gun nidhaan har paiaa sahaj kare veechaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He finds the Lord, the treasure of excellence, and peacefully contemplates Him.","ms":"He attains the Lord, the Treasure of virtues and tranquilly meditates on Him."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਗੁਣਾਂ ਦੇ ਖ਼ਜ਼ਾਨੇ ਹਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਆਤਮਕ ਅਡੋਲਤਾ ਵਿਚ ਟਿਕ ਕੇ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੇ ਗੁਣਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਜੋੜੀ ਰੱਖਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":28123,"page_no":650,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਧੰਨੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"dha(n)n vaapaaree naanakaa jis gurmukh naam adhaar ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Blessed is the trader, O Nanak, who, as Gurmukh, takes the Name as his only Support. ||1||","ms":"Blessed is the trader, O Nanak, who, through the Guru, obtains the Lord's Name as his support."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ‘ਨਾਮ’ ਆਸਰਾ (ਰੂਪ) ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਨਾਮ ਦਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਮੁਬਾਰਿਕ ਹੈ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2475,"next":2477}}
files.shabads/4/2477.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2477,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":13,"page_no":650,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":28124,"last_verse_id":28128,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Sorath","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":28124,"page_no":650,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Third Mehla:","ms":"3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":28125,"page_no":650,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਵਿਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਿਝਈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"vin man maare koi na sijhiee vekhahu ko liv lai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without conquering his mind, no one can be successful. See this, and concentrate on it.","ms":"Without subduing his mind no man attains success. Let any one see it through deep deliberation."},"pu":{"ss":"ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕੋਈ ਭੀ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਬ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਜੋੜ ਕੇ ਵੇਖ ਲਵੋ, ਮਨ ਨੂੰ ਕਾਬੂ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਕੋਈ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਿੱਝਿਆ (ਭਾਵ, ਕਿਸੇ ਦੀ ਘਾਲਿ ਥਾਇ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਈ); "}}},{"verse_id":28126,"page_no":650,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਤੀਰਥੀ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"bhekhadhaaree teerathee bhav thake naa eh man maariaa jai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The wandering holy men are tired of of making pilgrimages to sacred shrines; they have not been able to conquer their minds.","ms":"The Pseudo-saints grow weary of roaming at the holy places, but this mind is subdued not."},"pu":{"ss":"ਭੇਖ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ (ਸਾਧੂ ਭੀ) ਤੀਰਥਾਂ ਦੀ ਯਾਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਹਨ, (ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ) ਇਹ ਮਨ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾਂਦਾ "}}},{"verse_id":28127,"page_no":650,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥","translit_en":"gurmukh eh man jeevat marai sach rahai liv lai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Gurmukh has conquered his mind, and he remains lovingly absorbed in the True Lord.","ms":"Through the Guru, this mind is overcome in man's life and he remains absorbed in the True Lord's love."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਹੋਇਆਂ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਸੱਚੇ ਹਰੀ ਵਿਚ ਬ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਜੋੜੀ ਰੱਖਦਾ ਹੈ (ਇਸ ਕਰਕੇ) ਉਸ ਦਾ ਮਨ ਜੀਊਂਦਾ ਹੀ ਮੋਇਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ (ਭਾਵ, ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚ ਵਰਤਦਿਆਂ ਭੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੋਂ ਉਦਾਸ ਹੈ) "}}},{"verse_id":28128,"page_no":650,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਇਉ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"naanak is man kee mal iau utarai haumai sabadh jalai ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, this is how the filth of the mind is removed; the Word of the Shabad burns away the ego. ||2||","ms":"Nanak, in this way, the filth of the mind is removed, the Name burns off the ego."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਇਸ ਮਨ ਦੀ ਮੈਲ ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਉਤਰਦੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ (ਮਨ ਦੀ) ਹਉਮੈ (ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ) ਸ਼ਬਦ ਨਾਲ ਸਾੜੀ ਜਾਏ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2476,"next":2478}}
files.shabads/4/2478.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2478,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":13,"page_no":650,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":28129,"last_verse_id":28134,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Sorath","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":28129,"page_no":650,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":28130,"page_no":650,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਹੁ ਇਕ ਕਿਨਕਾ ॥","translit_en":"har har sa(n)t milahu mere bhaiee har naam dhiraRaavahu ik kinakaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Saints of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny, please meet with me, and implant the Name of the One Lord within me.","ms":"Meet me, O Lord God's saints, my brothers, and implant in me even a particle of the Lord's Name."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਸੰਤ ਜਨੋਂ! ਇਕ ਕਿਣਕਾ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ (ਮੈਨੂੰ ਭੀ) ਹਰੀ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਾਵੋ "}}},{"verse_id":28131,"page_no":650,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਨਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਪਹਿਰਹੁ ਖਿਮ ਕਾ ॥","translit_en":"har har seegaar banaavahu har jan har kaapaR pahirahu khim kaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O humble servants of the Lord, adorn me with the decorations of the Lord, Har, Har; let me wear the robes of the Lord's forgiveness.","ms":"O God's slaves, bedeck me with the decoration of God's Name and make me wear the Divine dress of forgiveness."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਹਰੀ ਜਨੋਂ! ਹਰੀ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਦਾ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਬਣਾਵੋ, ਤੇ ਖਿਮਾ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਾਕ ਪਹਿਨੋ,"}}},{"verse_id":28132,"page_no":650,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਐਸਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਮ ਕਾ ॥","translit_en":"aaisaa seegaar mere prabh bhaavai har laagai piaaraa piram kaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such decorations are pleasing to my God; such love is dear to the Lord.","ms":"Such a decoration is pleasing to my Lord. The embellishment of love is dear to God."},"pu":{"ss":"ਇਹੋ ਜਿਹਾ ਸ਼ਿੰਗਾਰ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਚੰਗਾ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ, ਹਰੀ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਦਾ ਸ਼ਿੰਗਾਰ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ "}}},{"verse_id":28133,"page_no":650,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਇਕ ਪਲਕਾ ॥","translit_en":"har har naam bolahu dhin raatee sabh kilabikh kaaTai ik palakaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, day and night; in an instant, all sins are eradicated.","ms":"The Lord Master's Name, I utter day and night and, in an instant, It effaces all the sins."},"pu":{"ss":"ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤ ਹਰੀ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰੋ, ਇਕ ਪਲਕ ਵਿਚ ਸਾਰੇ ਪਾਪ ਕੱਟ ਦੇਵੇਗਾ "}}},{"verse_id":28134,"page_no":650,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਿਣਕਾ ॥੨੧॥","translit_en":"har har dhiaal hovai jis upar so gurmukh har jap jinakaa ||21||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord becomes merciful, chants the Lord's Name, and wins the game of life. ||21||","ms":"He, unto whom the Lord God becomes merciful, wins his life game, through the Guru, by meditating on the Lord's Name."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਉਤੇ ਹਰੀ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੰੁਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਹਰੀ ਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਰ ਕੇ (ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤੋਂ) ਜਿੱਤ (ਕੇ) ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।੨੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2477,"next":2479}}
files.shabads/4/2479.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2479,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":13,"page_no":651,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":5,"first_verse_id":28135,"last_verse_id":28139,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Sorath","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":28135,"page_no":651,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Third Mehla:","ms":"Slok 3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":28136,"page_no":651,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਕਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ਸਿਆਹੁ ॥","translit_en":"janam janam kee is man kau mal laagee kaalaa hoaa siaahu ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The filth of countless incarnations sticks to this mind; it has become pitch black.","ms":"The scum of so many births is attached to this soul and it has become pitch black."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਈ ਜਨਮਾਂ ਦੀ ਇਸ ਮਨ ਨੂੰ ਮੈਲ ਲੱਗੀ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਕਰਕੇ ਇਹ ਬਹੁਤ ਹੀ ਕਾਲਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਪਿਆ ਹੈ (ਚਿੱਟਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ"}}},{"verse_id":28137,"page_no":651,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਖੰਨਲੀ ਧੋਤੀ ਉਜਲੀ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਣਿ ਪਾਹੁ ॥","translit_en":"kha(n)nalee dhotee ujalee na hoviee je sau dhovan paahu ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The oily rag cannot be cleaned by merely washing it, even if it is washed a hundred times.","ms":"The oilman's rag turns not white by washing, even through it be washed a hundred times."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਵੇਂ ਤੇਲੀ ਦੀ ਲੀਰ ਧੋਤਿਆਂ ਚਿੱਟੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੰੁਦੀ, ਭਾਵੇਂ ਸੌ ਵਾਰੀ ਧੋਣ ਦਾ ਜਤਨ ਕਰੋ ।"}}},{"verse_id":28138,"page_no":651,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਉਲਟੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਤਿ ਬਦਲਾਹੁ ॥","translit_en":"gur parasaadhee jeevat marai ulaTee hovai mat badhalaahu ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By Guru's Grace, one remains dead while yet alive; his intellect is transformed, and he becomes detached from the world.","ms":"By Guru's grace, remains dead in life and his nature is altered and turned and away from the world."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਜੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਲ ਮਨ ਜੀਊਂਦਾ ਹੀ ਮਰੇ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਬਦਲ ਕੇ (ਮਾਇਆ ਵਲੋਂ) ਉਲਟ ਹੋ ਜਾਏ"}}},{"verse_id":28139,"page_no":651,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹੁ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"naanak mail na lagiee naa fir jonee paahu ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, no filth sticks to him, and he does not fall into the womb again. ||1||","ms":"Nanak, no impurity attaches to him then and he falls not into the womb again."},"pu":{"ss":"ਤਾਂ ਮੈਲ ਭੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਲੱਗਦੀ ਤੇ ਫਿਰ ਜੂਨਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਭੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੈਂਦਾ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":2478,"next":2480}}

files.shabads/4/2486.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2486,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":13,"page_no":651,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":4,"first_verse_id":28173,"last_verse_id":28176,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Sorath","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":28173,"page_no":651,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੩ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa teejaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Third Mehla:","ms":"3rd Guru."}}},{"verse_id":28174,"page_no":651,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਧੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰੈ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥","translit_en":"bin sabadhai sudh na hoviee je anek karai seegaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without the Word of the Shabad, purity is not obtained, even though the soul-bride may adorn herself with all sorts of decorations.","ms":"Without the Name, the bride becomes not pure, even through she may make many decorations."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾ (ਜੀਵ-ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ) ਭਾਵੇਂ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਸ਼ਿੰਗਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੁੱਧ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ"}}},{"verse_id":28175,"page_no":652,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥","translit_en":"pir kee saar na jaaniee dhoojai bhai piaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"She does not know the value of her Husband Lord; she is attached to the love of duality.","ms":"She knows not the worth of her spouse and is attached to another's love."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਿਉਂਕਿ) ਉਹ ਪਤੀ ਦੀ ਕਦਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾਣਦੀ ਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੰੁਦੀ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":28176,"page_no":652,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾ ਕੁਸੁਧ ਸਾ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਰੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੁਨਾਰਿ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"saa kusudh saa kulakhanee naanak naaree vich kunaar ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"She is impure, and ill-mannered, O Nanak; among women, she is the most evil woman. ||2||","ms":"Nanak, she is impure, she is of ill-conduct and, amongst women, an evil woman."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! files.shabads/4/2487.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2487,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":13,"page_no":652,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":6,"first_verse_id":28177,"last_verse_id":28182,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Sorath","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":28177,"page_no":652,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":28178,"page_no":652,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਬੈਣੀ ॥","translit_en":"har har apanee dhiaa kar har bolee bainee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Be kind to me, Lord, that I might chant the Word of Your Bani.","ms":"Bless me with Thine mercy, O Lord Master so that I may recite only the Divine word."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਹਰੀ! files.shabads/4/2488.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":2488,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":13,"page_no":652,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":9,"first_verse_id":28183,"last_verse_id":28191,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Sorath","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":28183,"page_no":652,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Fourth Mehla:","ms":"Slok 4th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":28184,"page_no":652,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਮਿਤੁ ॥","translit_en":"har dhaasan siau preet hai har dhaasan ko mit ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord loves His slaves; O Lord, O God, please, preserve his honor. ||1||","ms":"Serf Nanak is the servant of God.
